mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp does not correlate with subsequent market strength.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous month signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase > 5% does not correlate with subsequent market strength.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% does not correlate with subsequent market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% over the previous three months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase > 0.5% in 3 months does not correlate with subsequent market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase > 1% does not correlate with subsequent market strength.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent market strength.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of economic expansion, a simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% and 0.3 percentage points respectively over the previous quarter signals strong economic fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 0.5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent market strength in expansionary regimes.
